review_candidates.title: Projects Sales Engineers - Egypt
review_candidates.description: Company Description Saveto Group leads Al Rashed’s construction materials business and is the largest manufacturer of construction materials in the Middle East and North Africa, operating 20 factories and numerous production and logistics hubs across 11 countries. The company leverages advanced technology and innovation to design, manufacture, and distribute locally developed products and solutions from state-of-the-art R&D laboratories. Its fully automated facilities and strong infrastructure enable fast, reliable delivery supported by world-class technical assistance and customer service. Saveto serves diverse sectors including residential, commercial, educational, and infrastructure, providing integrated solutions under one roof to meet comprehensive customer needs. Guided by an inventive and customer-centric mindset, Saveto is committed to shaping a better-built world by anticipating customer needs and delivering high-quality tools that support meaningful spaces and communities. Role Description This is a full-time Projects Sales Engineer role based in Cairo, Egypt, with a hybrid work arrangement allowing some work from home. The Projects Sales Engineer will identify and pursue project-based sales opportunities, prepare technical and commercial proposals, and manage the sales cycle from initial contact through negotiation and closing. The role involves building and maintaining relationships with contractors, consultants, and developers, conducting site visits, and providing technical support on Saveto’s construction materials and solutions. The Projects Sales Engineer will collaborate with internal teams such as engineering, operations, and customer service to ensure timely delivery, quality, and after-sales support. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate sales reports, forecasting project pipelines, and representing Saveto Group at meetings, presentations, and industry events. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Project Sales and Sales skills, including pipeline development, proposal preparation, and deal closing. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills to engage stakeholders, handle inquiries, and provide ongoing support. Candidates should possess Sales Management skills, such as planning, forecasting, and performance tracking for project accounts. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Architecture, or related field) or a closely related discipline is preferred. Experience in construction materials, building systems, or project-based B2B sales in the Egyptian or regional market is an advantage. Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications, with strong problem-solving and negotiation capabilities. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools, along with a valid ability to travel locally for client visits and site meetings as required.

review_candidates.title: Analyst
review_candidates.company: OUST - Obour University for Science & Tech.
review_candidates.description: Company Description Obour University for Science & Technology (OUST) is a growing higher education institution located on the Belbeis Desert Road near Cairo, Egypt. The university focuses on science and technology disciplines, offering programs that prepare learners for modern, innovation-driven careers. OUST is committed to academic excellence, applied research, and strong connections to industry. The campus provides a collaborative environment where faculty, staff, and analysts work together to support student success and institutional development. Team members join an organization that is actively shaping the future of science and technology education in Egypt. Role Description The Analyst role at OUST is a full-time, on-site position based in Al Gharbiyah, Egypt. The Analyst will collect, organize, and analyze data related to academic programs, enrollment, operations, and institutional performance, generating reports and dashboards to support evidence-based decision-making. Daily tasks include validating data accuracy, identifying trends and risks, preparing summaries for leadership, and contributing to process improvement initiatives. The role collaborates with academic departments and administrative units to clarify data needs, develop metrics, and monitor key performance indicators. The Analyst also supports compliance and accreditation activities by providing timely, reliable data and documentation. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and derive actionable insights. Candidates should possess data management and reporting skills, including proficiency with spreadsheets, databases, and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar). Candidates should possess problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with a focus on accuracy, attention to detail, and process improvement. Candidates should possess communication and collaboration skills, including clear written reporting, presentation abilities, and the capacity to work with diverse stakeholders. Candidates should possess organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and maintain thorough documentation. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or a related discipline; a master’s degree is an advantage. Experience in higher education, institutional research, or a similar analytical environment is beneficial. Familiarity with statistical methods and software (such as R, Python, or SPSS) is an asset. Ability to work on-site in Al Gharbiyah, Egypt and engage effectively within a multicultural academic setting.

review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Home / Careers / Sales Engineer Sales Engineer March 15, 2025 Ahmed Yasser 0 Comments 0 tags Sales Engineer Job Description IGNITE is seeking a dynamic, motivated, results-driven and skilled sales engineer to manage and grow the sales of instruments and Automation systems within the Egyptian market. The ideal candidate will combine technical knowledge with sales expertise to support clients in industries such as O&G, Manufacturing, and Utilities. Key Responsibilities Sales and Business Development Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue targets in turn-key project at Automation system (PLC, SCADA, DCS) , field instruments and solar systems. Identify and engage in new business opportunities, build relationships with key stakeholders, and expand the client base within the instrumentation industry. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and present proposals tailored to customer needs. Technical Expertise Assist customers in selecting the appropriate instrumentation solutions for their specific requirements, ensuring technical accuracy and value alignment. Stay updated on the latest industry trends and advancements in field instruments. Project Involvement Collaborate with project teams to support the successful implementation of instrumentation solutions in large-scale projects. Act as a liaison between clients and internal teams to address project-specific challenges and ensure timely delivery. Customer Relationship Management Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers, providing exceptional after-sales support. Manage the sales pipeline effectively and maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales progress. Market Research and Strategy Conduct market analysis to identify trends, competitor offerings, and customer needs within the instrumentation sector. Provide feedback to the product development team to align Ignite’s offerings with market demands. Monitor market trends and identify business opportunities within the Egyptian market. Gather competitive intelligence to support strategic sales planning. Administrative Duties Prepare and deliver technical and commercial proposals. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, accurate sales forecasts, and requested activity reports. Proven ability to use enterprise systems ERP / CRM. Job Requirements Qualifications And Skills Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably in Instrumentation, Electronics, Process, or a related field. Experience Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in sales, with a strong focus on automation and field instruments. Experience in large-scale industrial projects is a considerable plus. Technical Skills Knowledge of industrial sectors such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, and OEM is highly advantageous. Familiarity with CRM tools and sales forecasting. Soft Skills Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Results-driven mindset with excellent negotiation and problem-solving abilities. Effective time management and organizational skills.
